locations.label: Spawn subway power
locations.description: Enable power at Spawn subway’s pillar, Disco roof beside Quickies, Park wall left of Deadeye Dewdrops and Main Street subway across from Bang Bangs. Collect a flyer (Dojo trash, Racin’ Stripes chair, Disco roof stool or Pink Cat sidewalk), the coin under sewer Tuff ’Nuff and a film reel (Disco couch, Pink Cat couch, subway boxes, sewer stairs or Rat King’s wall holes). Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Pink Cat projector
locations.description: Use the flyer on the Pink Cat front door, the coin on its left private-room door and the reel on the projector. The wall portal reaches Pack-a-Punch during each visit window. On/after Scene 5, speak to Pam in the Dojo, drink a Chi gourd and make fifteen melee kills in that style to unlock Shurikens. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Pam / Chi training
locations.description: Dragon, Tiger, Crane and Snake have independent upgrade progress. Start with melee kills, then complete the displayed style challenges to unlock Shuriken, special and ultimate tiers. Gourds recharge the ability and eventually respawn; changing style preserves its previous progress. Chi melee/Shurikens break the Torii barriers. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Disco roof spotlight
locations.description: Place the poster on the Disco roof spotlight. Explode the projected X window and defeat the spawned ninjas. An initial letter and six shootable Wyler glyphs now appear. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Upstairs DJ booth
locations.description: Interact with the upstairs Disco DJ booth. Keep another zombie on the active dance floor before killing the passive zombie carrying the disco ball; it transfers to that waiting target. Repeat ten transfers without ending the round. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Rat King arena
locations.description: Damage the Rat King until he retreats. Avoid firing continuously into his raised shield; Shurikens can destroy the staff temporarily. Select an organ and then the central floor symbol to start its challenge. Any challenge order is allowed. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
